title: Soveraeign Source
description: PROPOSED ahead of O10 (SPEC.md owner freeze pending). Compiles the SPEC.md Source information object: an immutable captured input identified by a stable address, bound to the digest and size of the bytes that address resolves to, and attributed to the actor that captured it. The bytes resolved by source_address must match payload_digest before a reading begins; a Source carries no payload itself. lineage/SOURCES.lock entries are Source records under this shape.

source_id.description: Identity of this source. Distinct from its address and its digest; coincidental equality never merges the roles.

source_address.description: Stable reference the bytes resolve from, for example git:<sha>, github:pr/<n>, claude-session:<id>, or a repository-relative path such as SPEC.md#Recording. An absolute host path (drive letter, leading slash or backslash, or UNC) is refused because it is neither portable nor stable across checkouts. Evaluated with Python re.search semantics.

payload_digest.description: Digest of the bytes resolved by source_address. A mismatch at capture is the DIGEST_MISMATCH refusal of capture_source; at reading it is the SOURCE_CHANGED refusal of read_source.

payload_size.description: Size in bytes of the resolved payload.

captured_at.description: When the source was captured, RFC 3339 with an explicit offset.

captured_by.description: Attributable identity of the actor that captured the source. Never a credential.
